title: Residual phUSD delta silently dropped in _settleResidualDelta causes ClaimArbitrage DoS
description: _settleResidualDelta(phUSD) silently returns at line 335 when no stableToUSDCPool[phUSD] is configured and phUSD != sUSDS. If any residual negative phUSD delta exists from the pump/unwind, it remains unsettled and the PoolManager reverts.
impact: ClaimArbitrage becomes non-functional if any residual phUSD delta exists after unwind. The silent return masks the issue, making debugging difficult.
attackPath: Execute ClaimArbitrage with pump/unwind that leaves a residual phUSD delta
_settleResidualDelta(phUSD) is called but no stableToUSDCPool[phUSD] is configured
phUSD is not sUSDS, so the function silently returns without settling
PoolManager detects unsettled delta and reverts the entire transaction
ClaimArbitrage is permanently DoSed for any scenario producing residual phUSD delta
recommendation: Either configure stableToUSDCPool[phUSD], add a fallback settlement path through phUSD_sUSDS_pool, or at minimum revert with a descriptive error.

relatedCode.description: _settleResidualDelta function with silent return at line 335
